body:
The Working the Bits overview still requires prior attendance and repeats fastest-shift/universal-inexactness claims corrected in its lessons. We now name the knowledge used, link optional support and summarise the five lessons with their actual width, range, precision and target-dependent boundaries.

We also align From Source to Silicon’s catalogue tagline/skills with its revised source/data and translation explanation. All module order/requires data is unchanged. The catalogue metadata correction does not imply its old tagline appeared on the built Foundations landing page.

Validation: production build passes (2459 public pages frame-checked); all 237 tests and content/prepared-tool checks pass; Vale and whitespace checks pass. Generated overview text and its three link destinations were inspected, the baseline overview fails the same wording check, and a structural YAML comparison limits the catalogue change to the selected tagline/skills. No machine behaviour or layout changes; no new learner/browser execution claimed.

Closes #752. Evidence and the complete per-unit map are in https://github.com/code198x/docs/pull/84 under stevehill1981/198x#114.
title: Align Foundations module summaries with their revised lessons
